WITH june_2022_cities AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS city_date
  FROM city_legislation.main.cities
  WHERE TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2022-06-30'
    AND country_code_2 IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
),
country_streaks AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    city_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY country_code_2 
      ORDER BY city_date
    ) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY country_code_2, 
      DATEDIFF('day', '1970-01-01', city_date) - DATEDIFF('day', '1970-01-01', 
        LAG(city_date) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY city_date)
      )
    ) AS streak_num
  FROM june_2022_cities
),
max_streaks AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM country_streaks
  GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_num
  HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(streak_length) 
    FROM (
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS streak_length
      FROM country_streaks
      GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_num
    ) AS all_streaks
  )
)
SELECT 
  country_code_2,
  streak_length
FROM max_streaks
ORDER BY streak_length DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH june_2022_cities AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS city_date
  FROM city_legislation.main.cities
  WHERE TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2022-06-30'
    AND country_code_2 IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CAST(insert_date AS DATE) IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    city_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY country_code_2 
      ORDER BY city_date
    ) AS row_num,
    DATEDIFF('day', '1970-01-01', city_date) AS date_num
  FROM june_2022_cities
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    row_num,
    date_num,
    date_num - row_num AS streak_num
  FROM ranked_dates
),
streaks_with_count AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code_2,
    streak_num,
    COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM streaks
  GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_num
),
max_streaks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2
  FROM streaks_with_count
  WHERE streak_length = (
    SELECT MAX(streak_length) 
    FROM streaks_with_count
  )
)
SELECT country_code_2
FROM max_streaks
ORDER BY country_code_2;
